channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nick Nurse | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nick Nurse from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Harris on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Josh Harris on the job Nick Nurse has done so far:

“Look, I think Nick had the team played hard, and there were a lot of things that happened. I think we all saw where there were various rosters that were available and rosters that weren't available.”

Josh Harris on Nick Nurse, May 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Mike Brown:

“I'd like to give my condolences again to Nick Nurse and his family. That's tough. That's bigger than what we're doing right now. I truly feel for him and the rest of his family”

Mike Brown on Nick Nurse, May 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Cameron Johnson on Steve Kerr, Mark Jackson, Nick Nurse, Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Cameron Johnson on Tom Thibodeau’s firing:

“It’s a copycat league and some teams have done it with a lot of success. You look at Golden State going from Mark Jackson to Steve Kerr, championships, dynasty run. You look at um Toronto going from Dwayne Casey to Nick Nurse and immediately coming up with a championship. So, I think that's kind of set a a precedent that like this can be a successful a a formula for winning to getting over the hump.”

Cameron Johnson on Steve Kerr, Mark Jackson, Nick Nurse, Tom Thibodeau, Jun 4, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Paul George on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Paul George:

“Nick Nurse, man, he’s a great coach. He knows how to get the best out of his players, and he’s proven that he can win at different levels. That’s huge for us. We need that kind of leadership to guide us through the tough times and help us reach our goals.”

Paul George on Nick Nurse, Jul 17, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Kyle Lowry on what it's like to play for Nick Nurse in the playoffs:

“He just wants to win. He's going to do whatever it takes to win. He's going to put us in positions to be successful. He's going to coach us, and coach us hard, because he loves to win.”

Kyle Lowry on Nick Nurse, Apr 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Kelly Oubre on Nick Nurse
item.description:
“But Coach Nurse has really brought it out of me. Just attacking, man, and realizing the force and the energy that I attract whenever I do, so somebody’s going to be open. I’ve got to find guys and be a playmaker, and I’m happy to do so.”

Kelly Oubre on Nick Nurse, Mar 22, 2024. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Cameron Payne on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Cam Payne on Nick Nurse as a communicator:

“He does a terrific job. I feel like he gets the most out of his guys. I feel like he challenges us. He knows what he can get out of his players, and he has a unique way of doing that.”

Cameron Payne on Nick Nurse, Mar 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on Nick Nurse
item.description:
The relationship between Nurse and Maxey is only eight months in, but the former Raptors coach has unleashed Maxey in ways unseen before.

“Coach Nurse has really instilled confidence in me and told me to be extremely aggressive. I appreciate him,”

Tyrese Maxey on Nick Nurse, Jan 25, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kelly Oubre on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Kelly Oubre:

“First and foremost before anything, I just want to say thank you to my family and my friends. The 76ers organization, especially coach (Nick) Nurse for the utmost support throughout this whole process,but I’ve spoken to the police about this situation and they have an ongoing investigation. So I’ve spoken to I need to speak to about it and people with the way that it is and I won’t be speaking on any details about that because they’re looking into it.”

Kelly Oubre on Nick Nurse, Dec 4, 2023. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: KJ Martin on Nick Nurse, Rico Hines
item.description:
KJ Martin on what makes the Sixers a good situation

“I know (Nick) Nurse. His coaching style, just from playing Toronto and stuff like that. He likes athletic guys. Obviously, I can defend the ball, play fast, and Rico Hines, he’s been working me out since I was like 15?So I’ve known Rico. He’s the one who really helped me, you know what I’m saying? Workout with NBA guys and kinda get me ready so I’m glad I’m here with him and he’s somebody I’ve worked on my game with every day.”

KJ Martin on Nick Nurse, Rico Hines, Nov 1, 2023. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Kelly Oubre on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Kelly Oubre on the @sixers under Nick Nurse:

“Coach Nick is a really good leader. He articulates what he wants from us, and makes it really simple for us to execute. I'm excited to continue to learn to elevate my game through him. He is who he is for a reason - He's a great.”

Kelly Oubre on Nick Nurse, Oct 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Daryl Morey:

“I understand there's skepticism. I understand there's a lot of things to figure out. ... Give us time, for me to work in the front office & get the players here that will help us win,and give Coach Nurse time to figure out how to put together a championship squad.”

Daryl Morey on Nick Nurse, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Oubre Jr. on Daryl Morey, Nick Nurse
item.description:
As Oubre Jr. prepares for his first season in Philadelphia, he spoke on why he signed with the Sixers and what he likes about the team.

“It was, obviously, late in the free agency period and I was really taking this offseason to kind of dial my life in and reenergize and refocus and Mr. (Daryl) Morey and coach Nick (Nurse), they were constantly trying to get in contact with me,”

Oubre Jr. on Daryl Morey, Nick Nurse, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Nick Nurse
item.description:
“This guy’s coming off an MVP season, but when you’re team is fractured at the top — when one of the top two players is like, ‘I’m out of here. The guy’s a liar’ — you’ve got no chance of winning. It’s really hard to win when you’re tied together as a group, and it’s really hard to win four seven-game series. That’s with everybody tied together, everybody pulling together. I feel really bad for Nick Nurse, too. You’ve got a new coach coming in, and Nick’s like, ‘Oh, boy. This ought to be interesting.’ It just disrupts the entire flow of the team, and it’s totally unnecessary.”

Joel Embiid on Nick Nurse, Aug 17, 2023. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Paul Reed on Nick Nurse, Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Paul Reed:

“I’ve talked to him [Nick Nurse] plenty of times and it’s always been kind of the same kind of idea. He talked about molding me into a Pascal Siakam-type player. Somebody who can kind of do it all. Shoot the ball, drive, pass, but right now, it’s all about focusing on my shot mechanics. That’s the start. That’s where it starts at.”

Paul Reed on Nick Nurse, Pascal Siakam, Jul 25, 2023. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Noah Levick:Daryl Morey on why Sixers landed on Nick Nurse in their coaching search:

“It was a pretty long list and we thought he was a pretty special candidate.”

Daryl Morey on Nick Nurse, Jun 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @NoahLevick.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Nick Nurse
item.description:
“We are absolutely thrilled to welcome Nick Nurse as the new head coach of the Philadelphia 76ers,”

Daryl Morey on Nick Nurse, Jun 1, 2023. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Scottie Barnes on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Scottie Barnes on Nurse's uncertain Raptors future:

“I love Nick. He allows us to play freely... He gives us a lot of freedom out there on the court. I guess we'll see what happens.”

Scottie Barnes on Nick Nurse, Apr 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Chris Boucher on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Vivek Jacob:Boucher on Nick Nurse helping his development:

“One thing Nick Nurse realized about me is I perform a lot better when somebody's hard on me. Sometimes I get comfortable and that's when it gets shaky, somehow, some way, he always knew to tell me, 'Chris, you're messing up.'”

Chris Boucher on Nick Nurse, Jul 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @vivekmjacob.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Masai Ujiri on reports of the Lakers' interest in Nick Nurse:

“No team has contacted me. And I see all the stuff that you guys see. I dream like they dream. I want Messi. I want Renaldo. I want Kobe Bryant. So they can keep dreaming. I dream too.”

Masai Ujiri on Nick Nurse, May 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Nick Nurse
item.description:
“His resume is a little bit like (Toronto Raptors coach) Nick Nurse. He’s coached all kinds of different places, all kinds of different situations.”

Rick Carlisle on Nick Nurse, Nov 30, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Khem Birch on Nick Nurse
item.description:
After spending some time learning from him, Birch now understands why Nurse is viewed as one of the NBA’s top coaches.

“Team Canada has a lot of potential, especially with coach Nurse. With the roster we had, I think he did a really good job,and I imagine if we had all our guys I think we would have won the whole thing,”

Khem Birch on Nick Nurse, Mar 30, 2020. Source: SportsNet.

item.title: Andrew Wiggins on Nick Nurse
item.description:
“That’s my main goal right now. And after that I’m going to decide on Canada basketball.“I never really got a chance to talk to too (many) of the guys, you know. I have great respect for coach (Nick) Nurse and I plan on having a conversation with him eventually.”

Andrew Wiggins on Nick Nurse, Jan 20, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Dwane Casey, Nick Nurse
item.description:
Lowry on Casey firing, Nurse hiring:

“I had no say in any of that. I didn't get asked. My job is to go hoop.”

Kyle Lowry on Dwane Casey, Nick Nurse, Nov 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Kawhi Leonard on Nick Nurse:

“He's open-minded, ready to adjust on the fly. Just a brilliant mind,loves the game of basketball. I've gotta talk to him more, this was just my first practice, but we're going to develop a good relationship.”

Kawhi Leonard on Nick Nurse, Sep 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Delon Wright on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Delon Wright on the coaching change:

“It's kind of a fresh start... (Nurse is) more of a no-tolerance type of coach. He wants things his way... Coach Casey had a different style of coaching, but I think they’re both effective. It just depends on how you take the message.”

Delon Wright on Nick Nurse, Jul 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Pascal Siakam on Nick Nurse
item.description:
Pascal Siakam on Nurse/the coaching change:

“It’s different. I know a lot of people think it’s not a change, but I think it’s a change. He’s his own man and he does things his way. It’s going to be interesting to see how things go, and I’m excited.”

Pascal Siakam on Nick Nurse, Jul 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.
